text:
### FCA Escalation (Customer-Initiated)  
**If Customer Unhappy:**
- FirstUK Bank provides FCA contact information
- Customer can escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS)
- FOS is independent, free to customer
- FOS decision is binding  
**Escalation Letter Must Include:**
- Statement of rights
- FOS contact: 0800 023 4567, www.financialombudsman.org.uk
- Time limit: Customer must escalate within 6 months of final response

raw_entities.description: Governs the mandatory process for customer-initiated escalations when a customer is unhappy with FirstUK Bank's services. Defines the bank's obligation to provide regulatory contact information, outlines the escalation path to the Financial Ombudsman Service, and establishes binding decision protocols.

raw_entities.description: Mandates that FirstUK Bank must proactively provide the Financial Conduct Authority's contact details to any customer who expresses dissatisfaction with bank services or decisions.

raw_entities.description: Requires the bank to inform customers of their right to escalate complaints to the independent Financial Ombudsman Service, ensuring they are aware it is free of charge and that its decisions are binding.

raw_entities.description: Stipulates that any formal escalation letter issued to a customer must explicitly contain a statement of their rights regarding the complaint process.

raw_entities.description: Establishes a strict deadline requiring customers to escalate their complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service within six months of receiving the bank's final response.
